mechanism_narrative: A recovery in workplace mobility from the sharp t-1w dip should lift weekday shopping and dining within four weeks because commuting restores incidental retail visits. If WORKPLACES stays above its t-1w low, RETAIL_REC should move upward relative to the prior four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -9.1 at t-1w then rebounded to -3.0 at t-0w while TRANSIT stayed near -9 to -10
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES remains near or below the t-1w trough and RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-weeks mean over the next 28 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in residential staying-home intensity should precede more discretionary outings and higher retail mobility within one to two weeks. As RESIDENTIAL eases from the mid-teens above baseline toward lower positive values, RETAIL_REC should increase.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls by at least 2 points from its prior weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL moved from 11.6 at t-3w to 7.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL declines by at least 2 points week-over-week and RETAIL_REC does not improve within the following two weeks, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When transit mobility crosses above its recent trough, retail visits should rise with a short lag because easier station access increases spontaneous shopping trips. The signal is only active once TRANSIT turns less negative than the prior two-week average.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above its average of the previous 2 weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed near -10 across all four weeks but improved slightly from -10.3 to -9.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT crosses above its prior-two-week average and RETAIL_REC does not rise in the same or following week, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Retail mobility will rise when parks and transit move in the same direction because combined leisure and access flows generate cross-shopping trips. A simultaneous increase in PARKS and TRANSIT within two weeks should pull RETAIL_REC upward.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped from -5.4 at t-2w to 2.3 at t-1w while TRANSIT remained low
failure_condition: If PARKS and TRANSIT both increase over a two-week span but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next two weeks, the interaction claim is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained grocery and pharmacy weakness signals a post-purchase substitution away from neighborhood retail corridors, which depresses retail mobility over the following month. If GROCERY_PHARM remains below the prior monthly average, RETAIL_REC should fall relative to the last four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was -5.7, -3.7, -6.9, and -7.1 across the four weeks
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays below its recent average yet RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold rebound in parks mobility should spill over into retail activity only after outdoor leisure turns positive, because higher park visitation increases adjacent food and shopping trips. Once PARKS becomes positive and remains positive for a week, RETAIL_REC should improve within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses above 0 after being negative in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -5.4 at t-2w to 2.3 at t-1w then back to -1.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS crosses above zero and then RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-weeks mean within four weeks, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in workplace mobility after a temporary rebound indicates renewed constraints or weaker commuting demand, which should push retail mobility lower within one to two weeks. The signal is stronger when TRANSIT does not recover at the same time.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by at least 5 points from its prior week while TRANSIT stays below -8
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rebounded to -1.3 at t-2w then dropped to -9.1 at t-1w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES drops sharply while TRANSIT remains weak but RETAIL_REC does not decline within two weeks, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Retail mobility should be flat or lower over the next month because all three activity proxies remain depressed together: transit is persistently around -10, workplaces remain negative, and residential stays elevated. This combination implies limited discretionary movement even if one series bounces briefly.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed between -8.4 and -10.3 while RESIDENTIAL stayed between 7.9 and 11.6
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain weak and RESIDENTIAL remains elevated but RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week average over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.
